note: AutoCAD LT remains a distinct commercial target. Today MyDesk Draft is the shared executable while LT-specific exclusions and LT command inventory are tracked here. A separate installer/binary may split later without deleting this target. Ambiguity: LT omits 3D modeling, Express Tools, and some automation present in full AutoCAD; those appear as unsupported-for-LT rather than Draft gaps.

capabilities.name: Professional 2D drafting core
capabilities.reference_behavior: LT focuses on 2D drafting, annotation, and plotting without 3D solid modeling.
capabilities.expected_output: Drawing persists with layers and dimensions
capabilities.differences: Shares MyDeskDraft binary today. Full LT menu/workspace parity incomplete.

capabilities.name: 3D solid modeling excluded by LT product scope
capabilities.reference_behavior: AutoCAD LT does not include 3D solid modeling. Tracking this as unsupported-for-LT prevents counting it against LT parity.
capabilities.differences: Out of AutoCAD LT product scope. Tracked so LT is not silently deleted from the catalog.

capabilities.name: Linetypes and lineweights
capabilities.command: LAYER LTYPE / CHPROP LTYPE / LTSCALE / LAYER LWEIGHT
capabilities.reference_behavior: LT supports layer and entity linetypes and lineweights for drafting and plot.
capabilities.differences: Same as Draft AutoCAD track for this capability.

capabilities.name: Layouts and PDF plot
capabilities.reference_behavior: Paper space layouts and PDF plot are core LT deliverables.

capabilities.name: DWG interoperability
capabilities.reference_behavior: Open and save DWG drawings used by LT customers.
